title: Hold stock during checkout
hints: Keep reservations in a Map: id → { sku, qty, expiresAt }.
available(sku) is on-hand stock minus the units in active (not expired) reservations for that sku. Make sell() check available(), not on-hand.
confirm(): make sure the reservation is still active, then lower the stock and delete the reservation. release() just deletes it.

hiddenTestRules.reservations > holds units: they are no: onHand(sku) still counts held units (they're still on the shelf).
hiddenTestRules.reservations > can't reserve more than i: Throws if fewer than qty units are available.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > gives every reservation i: returns a reservation id (any unique string).
hiddenTestRules.reservations > confirm takes the units o: confirm(id) completes the purchase: the units leave stock for good and the reservation ends.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > release makes the units a: release(id) cancels the reservation and the units become available again.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > stops holding units once: a reservation stops holding units as soon as ttlMs ms have passed (at exactly ttlMs it has already expired).
hiddenTestRules.reservations > can't confirm an expired,: Throws if the reservation doesn't exist, has expired, or was already confirmed or released.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > can't release an unknown,: Throws if there's no active reservation with that id.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > can't confirm the same re: Throws if the reservation doesn't exist, has expired, or was already confirmed or released.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > in-store sales respect re: sell(sku, qty) can't sell units someone else is holding.
hiddenTestRules.reservations > keeps products separate: Each product (sku) has its own stock and its own reservations.
